title: Composition of derived pro-etale module pullbacks
statement:
Let $h:Z\to W$ and $k:W\to V$ be morphisms of schemes, with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and inverse images $h^{-1},k^{-1},(kh)^{-1}$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $R_V,R_W,R_Z$ be sheaves of rings on $V_{\mathrm{proet}},W_{\mathrm{proet}},Z_{\mathrm{proet}}$ with identifications $k^{-1}R_V\cong R_W$ and $h^{-1}R_W\cong R_Z$, and give $(kh)^{-1}R_V$ the identification with $R_Z$ obtained through the canonical isomorphism $(kh)^{-1}\cong h^{-1}k^{-1}$. With the derived module pullbacks $Lh^*,Lk^*,L(kh)^*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] there is a canonical isomorphism of functors

$$
 c_{h,k}:L(k\circ h)^*\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Lh^*\circ Lk^*:\ D(V_{\mathrm{proet}},R_V)\longrightarrow D(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},R_Z),
$$

which on a K-flat complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ of $R_V$-modules with flat terms is the class of the termwise canonical isomorphism of module pullbacks $(kh)^*\mathcal K^\bullet\cong h^*k^*\mathcal K^\bullet$ (here $k^*\mathcal K^\bullet$ is again K-flat with flat terms, so it computes $Lk^*$ and $h^*k^*\mathcal K^\bullet$ computes $Lh^*Lk^*$).
